items.name: Ash of War: Stamp (Upward Cut)
items.japanese_name: 戦灰「踏み込み（斬り上げ）」 Ikusahai: Fumikomi (Kiriage)
items.summary: The Ash of War: Stamp (Upward Cut) is an Ash of War of Heavy Affinity in Elden Ring.
items.description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

"Stamp (Upward Cut): Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks. Follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike."

Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (small and medium swords excepted).
effect_details: Applies the skill Stamp (Upward Cut) to any infusable sword, axe, or hammer (except for small or medium swords): Greatswords, Colossal Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Curved Greatswords, Great Katanas Shadow of the Erdtree, Axes, Greataxes, Hammers, Flails, Great Hammers, and Colossal Weapons.

Compatible with the affinities Standard and Heavy by default, and also Keen and Quality if the Iron Whetblade has been acquired, Fire and Flame Art if the Red-Hot Whetblade has been acquired, Lightning and Sacred if the Sanctified Whetblade has been acquired, Magic and Cold if the Glintstone Whetblade has been acquired, and Poison, Blood, and Occult if the Black Whetblade has been acquired.
